wounds.jaymospowers.part.head: Head
commands.jaymospowers.wounds.unknown_par: That creature has no such part
message.jaymospowers.downed.down: You're down. Crawl to safety, or wait for someone to bring you round.
message.jaymospowers.downed.give_up: You're down. Hold sneak to give up [%s]
message.jaymospowers.downed.give_up_out: You've passed out. Hold sneak to give up [%s]
message.jaymospowers.wounds.battered: You're up, but battered: you won't heal past this till you've slept it off.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.battered_sle: A night's rest: you've shaken off the battering.
message.jaymospowers.downed.no_food: You've nothing to eat to bring %s round with.
message.jaymospowers.downed.no_treat: You've nothing %s would take to bring them round.
message.jaymospowers.downed.revived: %s is back on their feet (your %s went to them).
message.jaymospowers.wounds.broken: %s broken: it won't heal right until it's set
message.jaymospowers.wounds.sprained: %s sprained: it'll mend as you heal
message.jaymospowers.wounds.set: Your broken bones are set: they can heal now
message.jaymospowers.wounds.knit: A broken bone or sprain has healed
tooltip.jaymospowers.linen_bandage: Binds a cut and heals the part. On yourself, use: pick a part. On another, hold use: the worst; tap: pick a part.
tooltip.jaymospowers.rag: A poor bandage, and dirty: the wound may fester.
tooltip.jaymospowers.splint: Sets a broken arm or leg and eases it while it knits.
tooltip.jaymospowers.needle_and_thread: Stitches a bleeding cut shut. It stings.
tooltip.jaymospowers.smelling_salts: Under the nose of one who's down: up on the spot.
tooltip.jaymospowers.leeches: A little blood for a long while without pain.
tooltip.jaymospowers.poppy_syrup: Dwale: strong against pain. Never two at once.
death.attack.jaymospowers.bleeding.playe: %1$s bled to death from wounds dealt by %2$s
message.jaymospowers.wounds.bleeding: %s bleeding: bind it, or stitch it
message.jaymospowers.wounds.festering: %s festering: pour spirits or honey on it
message.jaymospowers.wounds.rotted: %s rotted past saving, and is gone
message.jaymospowers.wounds.tea: The bitter tea goes down. The pain will ease soon.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.poppy: A warm haze settles over everything.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.craving: Your hands shake. You need the poppy.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.treated_by: %s is treating you with %s. Hold still.
message.jaymospowers.downed.self_revived: Second Wind! You find the strength to get up.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.leeches_bad_: The leeches draw the bad blood out of %s: plague and poison.
message.jaymospowers.downed.come_round: You come round. Crawl, or wait for help.
message.jaymospowers.downed.roused: The salts sting you awake. You're up!
message.jaymospowers.downed.knocked_out: Too much poppy: you're out cold.
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.use_part: Hold use on another; tap: pick the part
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.rag.1: Stops a cut, but it's dirty
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.splint.1: Sets a broken arm or leg
screen.jaymospowers.wounds.body_sub: Pick a part. Hold still while it's done.
screen.jaymospowers.wounds.help: Hover a part to see its state; parts your medicine can't help are greyed.
screen.jaymospowers.wounds.look_sub: Hold a bandage, splint or the like to treat from here.
screen.jaymospowers.wounds.look_help: Hover a part to see how whole it is, and whether it's broken, bleeding or festering.
